calibration.note: A comparable pair of past cycles, used to test how much of an early-vote shift shows up in the result. Margins are two-party, D minus R, in points.

environment.note: Most recent statewide result, shifted by the change in the national environment since then.

national.note: National reference points. Margins are two-party, D minus R, in points.
